import json, sys
import mod.client.extraClientApi as api
from modern_projection.pyreact import navigator
from modern_projection.projection.model import Document
from modern_projection.projection.cell import make_cell
from modern_projection.projection.debug_blueprints import material
from modern_projection.projection.debug_banner_blueprints import observations
from modern_projection.projection.entity_overlays import banner_item
from modern_projection.projection.visible_actor import compose_actor
owner = api.GetSystem('ModernProjection', 'ModernProjectionClientSystem')
s, b = owner.session, owner.bridge
assert not hasattr(sys, '_shield_banner_geometry_r20')
assert not s.busy and s.edit_job is None and s.io_job is None and not s.projection_active
assert navigator.top is None or navigator.top.key == 'modern_projection_workspace'
fields = ('page', 'name', 'view', 'focus_view', 'section', 'solo_layer', 'focused', 'box_anchor',
          'canvas_x', 'canvas_z', 'paste_origin', 'paste_pinned', 'camera_pose', 'camera_yaw',
          'camera_pitch', 'zoom', 'camera_pan', 'camera_pivot', 'camera_depth', 'camera_depth_pose',
          'camera_focus_request', 'camera_reset_animated', 'progress', 'direct_mode', 'grid')
saved = {'editor': s.editor, 'fields': dict((key, getattr(s, key)) for key in fields),
         'workspace': navigator.contains('modern_projection_workspace'), 'rows': [],
         'controls': [], 'step': 0}
sys._shield_banner_geometry_r20 = saved
observed = observations()
for label, row in (('standing_pattern', observed[1]), ('wall_pattern', observed[4]),
                   ('standing_plain', observed[0])):
    mat = material(row['name'], row['states'])
    item = banner_item(mat, compose_actor(row['actor'], row['nbt']))
    doc = Document((1, 2, 1), name='Native banner item comparison ' + label)
    doc.blocks[(0, 1, 0)] = make_cell(mat, nbt=row['actor'])
    model = b.geometry(doc, name='shield_r20_v5_' + label)
    assert model
    saved['rows'].append({'label': label, 'item': item, 'model': model,
                          'native_actor': row['actor'], 'material': mat})
doc = Document((1, 1, 1), name='Temporary native banner item comparison')
doc.blocks[(0, 0, 0)] = material('stone')
s._loaded(doc)
s.grid = False
s.camera_view(0., 0., 2.)
owner.open_workspace()
_result = json.dumps({'rows': saved['rows'], 'main_scene': 'stone only'})
